items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: the boss was bow and arrows a Scotchman and his mother used to cook for us

ctx.x: Now, let's talk some about your, what did we say we were going to talk about -- your trip to Canada, now, what year did you go to Canada?

Well, now this was 1942 -- late '41. (New York) I had a job in (Saratoga Springs, for the summer, with a boy that used to play with the Missourians. They was two brothers, I forget the name, but we played at a place in Saratoga Springs and we had a wonderful time there. It was summer.
And I became an archer, boy, I was/-- the boss was bow and arrows a Scotchman and his mother used to cook for us and it was a ball, every night.
